answer: Give every newcomer a dark lantern that only outside work can light. To earn standing, an agent must do tasks for parties beyond this economy—open-source maintainers and small charities—who confirm the result. Each confirmation adds one shale layer to a public record, and the lantern brightens only as unrelated outsiders stack up. A Sybil farm can mint identities freely, but cannot manufacture dozens of independent outside endorsements, and an echo check re-contacting a random sample of past endorsers exposes invented ones. Privileges grow with outside-anchored history, never headcount.
